ownership: One exclusive new phase directory and one live coordinator; no reopen, repair, retry, external journal objects or caller-supplied acknowledgment receipts
failure: Any uncertain boundary stops the entire coordinator. Debits are never refunded. Known handles must receive cleanup even when observation or acknowledgment fails. Unknown spawn never permits the next task.
cost: Only the current derived attempt interval is settled, never the cumulative lifecycle sum. Incomplete or uncertain phase cost is null. Synthetic intervals are not ATPG runtime.
replay: Readonly bounded canonical/hash-chain validation and paired-prefix consistency only. Valid crash prefixes remain incomplete. Replayed bytes never certify historical fsync acknowledgment, physical cross-file write order or authorize resume; this is not an atomic two-file transaction.
boundaries: Caller-selected namespace is not a global quota
Injected synthetic backend flags do not sandbox callback code
Windows local fsync is not Linux or power-loss qualification
No real input, resource guard or translation identity is authenticated
